findings.resolution: ADD uses candidate evidence, DELETE uses base evidence plus exact tombstones, and MODIFY preserves independent base and candidate semantic versions under a pinned contract.
Every verified Git change, graph delta and tombstone is accounted through direct or indirect partitions; nonsemantic changes have an explicit no-seed outcome.
Historical roots bind before current repository and graph replay; aware UTC, future, expiry, refresh and rollback cases fail closed.
Residual graph freshness is temporal during current replay while model validation still proves the exact validity interval.
A linear owner-to-delta index and pinned total reference limits prevent change-by-delta scans and combinatorial output expansion.
The slice claims only supported-family local operation mapping; trusted paths, source-family, upstream, build/test and global release gaps remain blocking.
The receipt keeps exact aggregate direct and indirect partitions. A later obligation slice may add compact per-delta causal deliverables without strengthening this FOUNDATION claim.
